'''Darion Seville''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who was the matriarch of the [[Seville Family]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Seville was the mother of [[Yearo Seville]]. She liked to arrange duels between her [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for amusement. [[MdZ-BLK]] participated in a series of these duels, but eventually became so fed up that he attempted to kill Seville. However, Yearo stepped in and ionized the droid, saving his mother.
